v2 surrogate vs truth LC, seed 28

narrative_md: Rendering seed 28's truth trajectory under both surrogates: v1 RMS 0.104 mag / rho 2.09 (Band B) with a localized ~1.0 mag spike near t=110; v2 RMS 0.024 / rho 0.48 (Band A) with scattered ~0.2 mag spikes. The v1 and v2 error spikes are NOT co-located. This seed observation motivated the cloud-regime test (s060_v1_v2_cloud_compare). Renders the truth trajectory (render-at-truth).
